## Notes

Article on Stephen V. Cole's 1979 Starfire board wargame, reached through the Aurora (video game) redirect. States that Aurora, described as a 4X Dwarf Fortress in space, was originally based on an assistant program for Starfire, citing a Rock, Paper, Shotgun interview of 2013-11-21.
